description: A Lightning.js component for a weather app's settings page, including UI for units toggle and location search, with internal state management and demo search functionality.

methods.name: applyUnits
methods.description: Apply units (metric or imperial) to store and trigger weather refresh.

methods.name: focusRowIndex
methods.description: Set focus to a specified row and update focus flags.

methods.name: applyLocationSelection
methods.description: Set selected location in store and refresh weather.

methods.name: runSearch
methods.description: Perform demo search over static location data based on query.
